title: Lumora Insights 2.0 — Launch Go/No-Go
description: Leads review launch readiness for Insights 2.0 and make a conditional go for October 21st.

transcript.speaker: me
transcript.text: Okay, let's start. This is the go/no-go for Lumora Insights 2.0, targeting public launch on October 21st, two weeks from today.

transcript.speaker: me
transcript.text: I want to leave with a clear decision, or clear conditions. Imani, can you start with engineering status?

transcript.speaker: imani
transcript.text: Sure. Everything in launch scope is feature complete: the new funnel builder, anomaly alerts, and the SQL export. We have 212 test cases in the release suite and 198 pass, so about 93 percent.

transcript.speaker: tobias
transcript.text: What's in the other fourteen?

transcript.speaker: imani
transcript.text: Eleven are flaky date picker tests, which we've confirmed are test problems and not product bugs. Three are real. One is a P1: anomaly alerts fire twice when a workspace has two admins.

transcript.speaker: diego
transcript.text: That one would hurt us with customers. Double pings are how alerts get muted.

transcript.speaker: imani
transcript.text: Agreed. Kenji has a fix in review, and I expect it merged tomorrow.

transcript.speaker: tobias
transcript.text: And the other two?

transcript.speaker: imani
transcript.text: P2s. A CSV export that drops the last row when a funnel has more than ten thousand rows, and a tooltip that's cut off in Safari.

transcript.speaker: helena
transcript.text: Can the Safari tooltip wait? Our demo videos all use Chrome.

transcript.speaker: imani
transcript.text: It can wait. I'd ship it in a point release.

transcript.speaker: me
transcript.text: Okay. The double-alert P1 and the CSV bug are launch blockers. The tooltip is not.

transcript.speaker: arjun
transcript.text: On performance, we load tested at three times current traffic. Query p95 came out at 1.8 seconds, and our target was 1.5.

transcript.speaker: tobias
transcript.text: That's a miss. Where is the time going?

transcript.speaker: arjun
transcript.text: Mostly funnel queries on workspaces with more than 90 days of data. A materialized rollup table should take us to roughly 1.2 seconds.

transcript.speaker: imani
transcript.text: I've scoped that. It's about four days of work, plus a backfill I'd run over a weekend.

transcript.speaker: tobias
transcript.text: Now the elephant in the room. Arjun, the ingestion outage. How worried should we be?

transcript.speaker: arjun
transcript.text: We lost about two and a half hours of ingestion on October 1st. No data was lost, we replayed everything from the queue, but dashboards were up to ninety minutes stale.

transcript.speaker: arjun
transcript.text: Root cause was one large tenant flooding a single partition with no backpressure. The fix has two parts: per-tenant rate limits at the edge, and a dead-letter queue with replay tooling.

transcript.speaker: tobias
transcript.text: And the new anomaly alerts depend on that same pipeline, correct?

transcript.speaker: arjun
transcript.text: Yes. If ingestion lags, alerts are late or wrong. So I'm not comfortable launching without at least the rate limits in production.

transcript.speaker: me
transcript.text: When can we have them there?

transcript.speaker: arjun
transcript.text: I'll deploy the rate limits to production by October 14th, and I'll run a load test against them the day after.

transcript.speaker: imani
transcript.text: I'll pair on the dead-letter queue. It might slip past launch, but I'll have a minimal replay tool ready by the 16th.

transcript.speaker: tobias
transcript.text: I'm fine with that as long as the replay tool isn't a launch condition. The rate limits are.

transcript.speaker: me
transcript.text: Diego, how are customers feeling about it?

transcript.speaker: diego
transcript.text: Good overall. We have 14 design partners on the beta, and 11 gave us a 4 or 5 on satisfaction. The funnel builder is the clear favorite.

transcript.speaker: diego
transcript.text: The concern I'm hearing is from Brightpath Health. They kicked off yesterday, and their IT lead, Callum, asked pointedly about data freshness after the outage.

transcript.speaker: me
transcript.text: What did you tell him?

transcript.speaker: diego
transcript.text: The truth. We had an incident, here's the root cause, here's the fix timeline. I said I'd send a written summary.

transcript.speaker: me
transcript.text: Can you make sure that goes out before next week's follow-up? I want Brightpath to hear it from us.

transcript.speaker: diego
transcript.text: I'll send a customer-facing incident summary to Callum and Priyanka by Friday.

transcript.speaker: diego
transcript.text: Also, support docs. The help center articles for anomaly alerts are about 60 percent done.

transcript.speaker: tobias
transcript.text: Can we get those finished by the 17th? Support shouldn't be reading release notes to learn the product on launch day.

transcript.speaker: diego
transcript.text: Yes, I'll get the remaining help center articles done by the 17th.

transcript.speaker: helena
transcript.text: On marketing, the launch blog post and landing page are drafted. The press embargo lifts at 9 a.m. Pacific on October 21st, and we have three trade outlets lined up.

transcript.speaker: helena
transcript.text: The risk is that the pricing page changes depend on the new Team plan, which finance hasn't signed off on.

transcript.speaker: me
transcript.text: I'll chase that. I'll get the Team plan pricing approved by Fatima by Monday.

transcript.speaker: helena
transcript.text: Thanks. The launch webinar is booked for the 28th, with 340 registrants so far.

transcript.speaker: tobias
transcript.text: What's the target?

transcript.speaker: helena
transcript.text: 500. We'll send two more email pushes. I also need the UI frozen by the 16th so I can record a three-minute walkthrough for the launch post.

transcript.speaker: me
transcript.text: UI freeze on the 16th works. Imani, flag it if the bug fixes need UI changes.

transcript.speaker: imani
transcript.text: Only the tooltip, which we're deferring anyway, so we're fine.

transcript.speaker: me
transcript.text: Alright, let's decide. The blockers so far: the double-alert P1, the CSV export bug, rate limits in production, and the p95 rollup. Did I miss anything?

transcript.speaker: tobias
transcript.text: Add the Team plan pricing sign-off. Otherwise that's the list.

transcript.speaker: arjun
transcript.text: One more, a rollback plan. All the new features are behind feature flags, so we can switch them off per workspace in minutes. I'll document the runbook.

transcript.speaker: me
transcript.text: Do I hear a go, conditional on those items by October 16th?

transcript.speaker: tobias
transcript.text: Conditional go from me.

transcript.speaker: imani
transcript.text: Conditional go. The rollup is tight but doable.

transcript.speaker: arjun
transcript.text: Conditional go, with the rate limits as my hard line.

transcript.speaker: diego
transcript.text: Go from customer success.

transcript.speaker: helena
transcript.text: Go from marketing, but I need the UI freeze to hold.

transcript.speaker: me
transcript.text: Then it's a conditional go. We hold a final checkpoint on the 16th, and if the rate limits or the P1 aren't done, we slip the launch one week to October 28th.

transcript.speaker: tobias
transcript.text: Fair. Let's put that in writing.

transcript.speaker: me
transcript.text: I'll send the decision and conditions to the company channel this afternoon.

summary.overview: The team reviewed readiness for the Insights 2.0 launch targeted for October 21st. Engineering reported 198 of 212 release tests passing, one P1 (duplicate anomaly alerts) and a CSV export bug as blockers, and a p95 query time of 1.8s against a 1.5s target. The October 1st ingestion outage made per-tenant rate limits a hard launch condition. Customer success and marketing reported being on track, and the group made a conditional go with a final checkpoint on October 16th and a fallback launch date of October 28th.

notes.title: Readiness status and open bugs
bullets: 198 of 212 release tests pass; 11 failures are flaky date picker tests, 3 are real bugs.
P1: anomaly alerts fire twice for workspaces with two admins; fix is in review.
Blockers are the double-alert P1 and the CSV export bug dropping the last row above 10,000 rows; the Safari tooltip is deferred.

notes.title: Performance and the ingestion outage
bullets: Load test at 3x traffic gave p95 of 1.8s against a 1.5s target; a rollup table should reach about 1.2s.
The October 1st outage delayed ingestion by about 2.5 hours with no data loss; cause was one tenant flooding a partition.
Per-tenant rate limits must be in production by October 14th; the replay tool by the 16th is not a launch condition.

notes.title: Customer and support readiness
bullets: 14 beta design partners, 11 rated satisfaction 4 or 5; the funnel builder is the favorite.
Brightpath Health raised data freshness concerns and is owed a written incident summary.
Anomaly alert help center articles are about 60% done and must finish by the 17th.

notes.title: Marketing and launch plan
bullets: Launch post and landing page are drafted; press embargo lifts 9 a.m. Pacific on October 21st with three outlets lined up.
Pricing page depends on Team plan sign-off from finance.
Launch webinar on the 28th has 340 of 500 target registrants; UI freeze set for the 16th.

notes.title: Decision and rollback plan
bullets: Blockers: double-alert P1, CSV bug, rate limits in production, the p95 rollup, and Team plan pricing.
All new features sit behind feature flags, giving a per-workspace rollback.
Unanimous conditional go; checkpoint on October 16th, slipping to October 28th if rate limits or the P1 are not done.

action_items.text: Deploy per-tenant rate limits to production by October 14th and load test them the next day
Have a minimal replay tool ready by October 16th
Send a customer-facing incident summary to Callum and Priyanka at Brightpath by Friday
Finish the remaining help center articles for anomaly alerts by the 17th
Get the Team plan pricing approved by Fatima by Monday
Document the feature-flag rollback runbook for Insights 2.0
Send the go/no-go decision and conditions to the company channel this afternoon
